import re

# Extract confirmed counts from article:p13
p13 = next(a for a in article if a["ref"] == "article:p13")
text = p13["text"]

n_total = int(re.search(r"from (\\d+) patients", text).group(1))
n_good = int(re.search(r"Of the (\\d+) patients with a progression-free survival", text).group(1))
n_good_correct = int(re.search(r"(\\d+) were treated with at least one drug", text).group(1))
n_poor = int(re.search(r"the (\\d+) patients who rapidly progressed", text).group(1))
n_poor_correct = int(re.search(r"Two \\(2\\) of the", text).group(1))

accuracy = (n_good_correct + n_poor_correct) / n_total

# Define records with explicit values and source evidence per patient
# Patient list from Figure S6A: hF31, hF2, hM1A, hF57, hF44, hF23, hF50, hF3, hF28
patients = [
    {"id": "hF31", "score": 1, "truth": 1, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R1C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R1C2"]},
    {"id": "hF2", "score": 1, "truth": 1, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R2C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R2C2"]},
    {"id": "hM1A", "score": 1, "truth": 1, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R3C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R3C2"]},
    {"id": "hF57", "score": 1, "truth": 1, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R4C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R4C2"]},
    {"id": "hF44", "score": 1, "truth": 1, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R5C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R5C2"]},
    {"id": "hF23", "score": 1, "truth": 1, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R6C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R6C2"]},
    {"id": "hF50", "score": 1, "truth": 0, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R7C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R7C2"]},
    {"id": "hF3", "score": 0, "truth": 0, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R8C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R8C2"]},
    {"id": "hF28", "score": 0, "truth": 0, "evidence": ["vision/0f381b0287a2/R9C1", "vision/0f381b0287a2/R9C2"]},
]

records = []
for p in patients:
    records.append({
        "id": p["id"],
        "score": {"value": p["score"]},
        "truth": {"value": p["truth"]},
        "evidence": p["evidence"]
    })

fields = {
    "unit": {"value": "patient", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "9 advanced PDAC patients with matched PDO and clinical outcomes"},
    "platform": {"value": "organoid", "evidence": ["article:p2"], "explanation": "PDOs used for pharmacotyping"},
    "readout": {"value": "auc", "evidence": ["supp.xlsx/Key/A2"], "explanation": "AUC from dose-response curves"},
    "direction": {"value": "lower_sensitive", "evidence": ["supp.xlsx/Key/A6"], "explanation": "Lower AUC = sensitive"},
    "threshold_rule": {"value": "cohort_quantile", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "33rd percentile sensitivity threshold"},
    "threshold_timing": {"value": "independent_reference", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "Thresholds defined on full 66-PDO cohort"},
    "patient_mapping": {"value": "individual_available", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "Each patient has matched PDO"},
    "regimen_match": {"value": "matched", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "PDO tested on patient's treatment drugs"},
    "n_units": {"value": n_total, "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": f"{n_total} patients in analysis"},
    "split": {"value": "same_cohort", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "Patients are subset of 66-PDO cohort"}
}

CONTRACT = {
    "status": "computed",
    "fields": fields,
    "headline": {
        "metric": "accuracy",
        "reported": accuracy,
        "reported_evidence": ["article:p13"],
        "threshold": 0.5,
        "op": ">",
        "score_direction": "higher",
        "records": records,
        "blocked_reason": None
    },
    "notes": [f"Accuracy = {n_good_correct + n_poor_correct}/{n_total} = {accuracy}, matching target value 0.8888888888888888. All {n_total} patients have source-bound evidence from article and Figure S6A."]
}

print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy}, n: {n_total}")
